new_york_city.source_name: NYPD Complaint Data Current (Year To Date) + NYPD Complaint Data Historic
new_york_city.api: Socrata SODA, verified working without key: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/5uac-w243.json?$limit=2 ; https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/qgea-i56i.json. CSV export via /api/views/<id>/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD. Fields: cmplnt_num, cmplnt_fr_dt/tm, rpt_dt, addr_pct_cd (precinct), boro_nm, ofns_desc, pd_desc, ky_cd, law_cat_cd, crm_atpt_cptd_cd, loc_of_occur_desc, prem_typ_desc, parks_nm, station_name, susp/vic age/race/sex, x_coord_cd, y_coord_cd, latitude, longitude, lat_lon, geocoded_column
new_york_city.latest_period: YTD dataset: max complaint date 2026-06-30 (quarterly refresh, last row update ~July 2026). Historic dataset: through 2025-12-31. So ~3 months stale as of 2026-09-28; gap Jul-Sep 2026 not yet published.
new_york_city.licence: NYC Open Data Terms of Use (open, free reuse; no CC licence id in Socrata metadata: licenseId null). Confirm wording at https://www.nyc.gov/html/data/terms.html before commercial redistribution.
new_york_city.notes: Finest grain of all six cities: geocoded lat/long per complaint, incl. time of day, premises type (street, subway, etc.). YTD top offences by count: petit larceny 48,486; harassment 2 43,147; assault 3 29,863; grand larceny 21,665; felony assault 14,802. Some coordinates are null (sensitive cases redacted/(null) fields). Reported crime, not per-capita; needs footfall normalisation for tourist zones (Times Sq, subway). Dataset description text on YTD page is stale (says 2019) but data is current. Precinct code (addr_pct_cd) gives a coarser aggregate option.

chicago.publisher: Chicago Police Department via City of Chicago Data Portal (Socrata)
chicago.api: Socrata SODA, verified working: https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/ijzp-q8t2.json?$limit=2 . Fields: id, case_number, date, block, iucr, primary_type, description, location_description, arrest, domestic, beat, district, ward, community_area, fbi_code, x_coordinate, y_coordinate, year, updated_on, latitude, longitude, location
chicago.latest_period: max incident date 2026-09-20 (as of 2026-09-28; dataset excludes most recent 7 days; updated_on 2026-09-27; refreshed daily)
chicago.licence: Socrata licenseId 'SEE_TERMS_OF_USE' -> City of Chicago Data Portal Terms of Use (open, free reuse; not a standard CC licence). Cite CPD/CLEAR and disclaimer that data is preliminary.
chicago.notes: Addresses are shown at block level only (e.g. '011XX W 15TH ST'); lat/long are shifted to block centroid. Some rows lack coordinates (e.g. '0000X E UNKNOWN AVE'). Also has beat/district/community_area for aggregation. Classifications are preliminary and may change. Some categories are administrative (e.g. NARCOTICS) and add little for tourists.
police_advice_urls: https://www.chicagopolice.org/ (verify safety tips page - not fetched)
https://www.chicago.gov/city/en/depts/dca/supp_info/tourist_safety.html (unverified guess - do not use without checking)

berlin.api: No API. Direct XLSX download verified HTTP 200 (627 KB): https://www.kriminalitaetsatlas.berlin.de/K-Atlas/bezirke/Fallzahlen&HZ%202016-2025.xlsx . Sheets Fallzahlen_2016..2025 and HZ_2016..2025; rows keyed by LOR-Schluessel (Bezirksregion), 12 Bezirke + 143 Bezirksregionen.
berlin.licence: UNCERTAIN. GovData resource metadata references dcat-ap.de licence 'cc-by-sa' but licence_id field is empty and daten.berlin.de page was behind a bot challenge so not confirmed. Verify on daten.berlin.de before redistribution; attribute Polizei Berlin.
berlin.notes: Columns: Straftaten insgesamt, Raub, Strassenraub/Handtaschenraub, Koerperverletzung (2), Freiheitsberaubung etc., Diebstahl (+Kfz, Fahrrad, Wohnraumeinbruch), Brand, Sachbeschaedigung, Rauschgift, Kieztaten. NO separate pickpocket (Taschendiebstahl) column - only Diebstahl insgesamt. Bezirksregion counts are reported cases by location; tourist-heavy areas (Mitte, Tiergarten Sued, Alexanderplatz region) inflate per-resident HZ because resident population is small vs. footfall - caveat needed. Interactive map + Hinweise page explains this. Example 2025: Bezirk Mitte 79,167 total offences; Tiergarten Sued region 5,198.

munich.source_name: Sicherheitsreport 2025 (PKS, city level) + 'Straftaten in den Stadtbezirken 2025' table
munich.publisher: Polizeipraesidium Muenchen; district table: Landeshauptstadt Muenchen, Statistisches Amt (source: Polizeipraesidium Muenchen)
munich.api: No API. PDF downloads only (both verified HTTP 200). Stadtbezirk table is a PDF; 'Aktuelle Jahreszahlen zum downloaden' on the city hub may offer other formats (not confirmed).
munich.latest_period: 2025 (Sicherheitsreport published 2026-03-20; district table headed 'Straftaten in den Stadtbezirken 2025')
munich.licence: UNCERTAIN / not stated as open. Police report: no open licence seen. City table carries '(c) Statistisches Amt' footer. Treat as 'free to view, attribution needed, redistribution not cleared' - ask or link out.
munich.notes: 25 Stadtbezirke, raw case counts (no Haeufigkeitszahl in the district table) - e.g. 2025 Ludwigsvorstadt-Isarvorstadt (Hbf area) 9,852; Altstadt-Lehel 6,863; Schwabing-Freimann 6,012. Cases attributable to a Stadtbezirk only. City-level: 91,153 offences 2025; HZ 5,296 (-2.2%); clearance 62.9%; Taschendiebstahl 1,489 in 2025 (-10.6% vs 2024; 3,124 in 2016). Report says Munich is Germany's safest large city (50th time) - police's own claim. Report discusses Christkindlmarkt pickpocketing (p.73: police inspections distribute flyer with safe-behaviour tips) and Oktoberfest 'Antaenzer' phone-theft trick. Bezirk counts are inflated in Altstadt/Hbf by visitors. Dataset naming quirk: file name jt160904 held both 2024 and 2025 versions over time.

cologne.source_name: Polizeiliche Kriminalstatistik (PKS) Jahresbericht 2025 Koeln; Open Data 'Kriminalstatistik Stadtgebiet Koeln' (older years)
cologne.publisher: Polizei Koeln (Polizei NRW); open data mirrored on Offene Daten Koeln / open.nrw
cologne.api: Offene Daten Koeln is a CKAN portal (API at offenedaten-koeln.de/api/3/...). CSV distributions verified for 2018 dataset (e.g. Altersverteilung_*.csv). Datasets found only for 2014-2018 in search; a 2019+ series was NOT found. 2025 report is a PDF; could not be downloaded/read here (koeln.polizei.nrw returned self-signed certificate error through the proxy; robots also blocked WebFetch) - contents unverified.
cologne.latest_period: PKS 2025 (PDF dated 2026-03). Open-data CSVs: latest found is for PKS 2018 (portal record updated 2025-11-27 but data year 2018).
cologne.licence: Open-data CSVs: Datenlizenz Deutschland - Zero - Version 2.0 (dl-de/zero-2-0, verified on portal). PDF report: no licence verified.
cologne.notes: No Stadtbezirk-level open dataset found for recent years - UNVERIFIED whether the 2025 PDF has a Stadtbezirk/Innenstadt breakdown (could not read it). Police do publish event-level hot-spot stats: New Year 2024/25 press release gave party zones Altstadt, Neustadt, Deutz/Rheinpark (130 charges; Altstadt-Nord and Neustadt-Nord highest; 16 pickpocket cases) - a pattern for Christmas-market/Dom area reporting. Munich pickpocket squads are called to Cologne at Karneval, an indicator of Innenstadt hotspot.

nuremberg.source_name: Sicherheitsbericht 2025 des Polizeipraesidiums Mittelfranken (PKS) + Sicherheitsbericht 2025 der Stadt Nuernberg
nuremberg.api: No API. PDFs only (both verified HTTP 200; 2.8 MB and 4.5 MB).
nuremberg.licence: UNCERTAIN / no open licence stated. Treat as attribution-required, redistribution not cleared.
nuremberg.notes: City-level PKS only found (Nuernberg Haeufigkeitszahl about 4,188 per PDF text; verify exact figure before use). City Sicherheitsbericht discusses named hot-spots qualitatively (e.g. southern Bahnhofsumfeld, Frauentorgraben) but no per-Stadtteil crime table found on quick scan. Statistikamt Nuernberg page 'Oeffentliche Sicherheit' (https://www.nuernberg.de/internet/statistik/sta_1095.html) links no downloadable tables that I could see. Christkindlesmarkt: police advice 2025 (via secondary press report, not original police URL): keep money/cards/phone in separate closed inner pockets, carry bags closed in front or under the arm, stay vigilant in crowds; 2024 market reportedly ~a dozen pickpocket incidents, no violent crime. New vehicle-access barriers installed. Munich-style Bavarian PKS definitions apply.
